decision: Night shift work: no US occupational standard (exposure unregulated)
note: IARC Vol 124 (2020): Group 2A, limited human evidence (breast/prostate/colorectal), sufficient animal, strong mechanistic. Denmark compensates breast cancer after long-term night work as occupational disease (K-flag, search backend unavailable at revision). US: no OSHA standard; NIOSH guidance only. Exposure misclassification risk: studies code ever/never night work; rotation pattern (permanent night vs forward/backward rotation vs weekly day-night flip) not captured -> residual confounding of dose. Cost-bearer: employers (scheduling/compensation costs).
